_meta.source_game: Zeliard, MS-DOS English release (Sierra 1990). Japanese-version differences: japanese_balance.json.
_meta.source_root: research/zeliard-expanded/extracted/zeliard-main/3_Assembly (tasm/bin release binaries; ida/*.asm annotations used for navigation only)

join_keys.accessory.id: value stored in the wearable list 0xA1..0xA5 and the equipped-wearable byte 0x9E (1..5)
join_keys.consumable.id: value stored in the 5 item slots 0xA6..0xAA (1..8); also the bit order of the magic-shop stock bytes 0xC9..0xD1 (bit 0x80 = id 1 ... 0x01 = id 8)
join_keys.drop_code: cavern object / monster drop code (enemies.json mechanics.drops)
join_keys.town keys: muralla, satono, bosque, helada, tumba, dorado, llama, pureza, esco (towns.json)
join_keys.save_flag: byte offset in the 256-byte save record (stdply) and bit mask

_meta.price_source: 212ARMRP.bin @0BAB9 (9 towns x 12 swords/shields, 24-bit prices) and 215DRUGP.bin @0B11E (9 towns x 8 magic items). Every item has a price in every town; the stock bitmask decides what is offered. Full tables and shop texts: towns.json.
_meta.evidence_levels: 'verified' = read from the release code/data; 'community' = walkthroughs, manual, TCRF, not traced in code.

equipment_rules.one_of_each: The hero holds exactly one sword and at most one shield. Buying replaces the current one.
equipment_rules.trade_in: floor(this town's price of the OLD item / 2) is credited, and the old item's bit is set in this town's stock byte so it can be bought back. verified (212ARMRP).
equipment_rules.sell_magic_items: floor(this town's price / 2). verified (215DRUGP, per towns fork).

starting_equipment.note: The King gives 1000 gold on the first audience (210KINGP). See progression.json starting_state.

swords.damage_formula: d = min(255, base + floor(level/2)); d = min(255, d * (sabre_oil + 1)); downward thrust in the air-to-ground stab (sword_hit_type 2) doubles d (cap 255) and forces the monster's first drop descriptor. Source: 200FIGHT Get_Stats (cs:6038). verified.
swords.reach_note: Sword hitbox/reach per sword type was not traced in this pass (treat as identical unless the fight code shows otherwise). Vista's gate is a damage multiplier (x32 for sword ids 4..6), not reach. See bosses.json vista.
swords.overhead_swing: Up+attack swings overhead; it also triggers automatically when a monster is in the 8x4 cell area above the hero.

list.name: Knight's Sword
sold_in: tumba (only via Crest of Glory exchange)
list.notes: Tumba lists it at 4900 but refuses to sell; carrying the Crest of Glory (0x9B) triggers a free exchange: sword := 4, old sword lost with no trade-in, crest cleared, Tumba stock bit 0x10 removed, flag 0x24 |= 0x02. First sword that can damage Vista.

list.name: Enchantment Sword

prices.note: placeholder price; never stocked by default. Trade-in value 2 gold. If traded in it appears in that shop for 4 gold (TCRF).

list.found: Cavern of Arrugia (world 6, behind the Lion's Head Key door). Map placement: game/data/world/.

shields.capacity_source: 212ARMRP word table @0A6BF: 1E 00 50 00 B4 00 2C 01 2C 01 58 02. On purchase shield HP (0x94) and shield max HP (0x96) are both set to this value. verified.
shields.contact_damage_rule: Monster contact while the hero FACES the attacker and carries a shield: reduced = (d >> 1) >> ((tier + 1) >> 1). The reduced value is subtracted from the hero's HP AND from shield HP. Shield HP <= 0: shield type and HP set to 0, message 'Shield broken.'. Contact from behind, or with no shield: full d to HP. verified (200FIGHT apply_hit_from_left/right).
shields.projectile_rule: Enemy projectile (13-byte record, +6 = damage) is blocked with no damage to hero or shield when: a shield is carried, the sword is not mid-swing, the hero is not on a rope, the projectile is horizontal/diagonal, and the hero faces it. Honor/Light/Titanium (ids 4..6) block at any height; Clay/Wise/Stone only at the covered height. Otherwise full damage to HP. verified (200FIGHT sub_846F, ida/fight.asm 5600-5690).
shields.repair: Weapon shop 'Repair shield': ceil((max - current) / 2) gold. Not free (community sources say free; code wins).
shields.holy_water: Item 6 adds [80, 90, 100, 110, 115, 120][tier-1] shield HP, capped at max. No effect without a shield.

list.name: Light Shield
list.notes: Same capacity as Honor but halves the damage again.

accessories.rules: Wearables are collected into the list 0xA1..0xA5 (ids in acquisition order). Only one is worn at a time (0x9E), chosen in the inventory screen (201SELCT). Effects only apply while worn.

list.name: Feruza Shoes
list.effect: jump height 4 instead of 2 (200FIGHT jump table). verified
list.found: Cavern of Arrugia (world 6, behind the Lion's Head Key door; community). Map: game/data/world/.

list.name: Pirika Shoes
list.effect: immune to hazard tiles (Gelroid, thorns, fire tiles) that otherwise do [1,1,4,8,20,20,20,20,20][cavern_level-1] per frame. verified
list.found: chest in the Corroer cavern (world 5), save flag 0x22 bit 0x02 (towns.json condition table).

list.name: Silkarn Shoes
list.found: world 6 (gold caverns) per community and Dorado dialogue. Map: game/data/world/.

list.name: Ruzeria Shoes
list.effect: no slipping on level-4 ice. verified

list.name: Asbestos Cape
list.effect: prevents world-7 heat damage (15 HP every 64 frames, 'It's too hot !!'). verified
list.found: bought from Llama NPC 1 for 2500 ALMAS (not gold); save flag 0x34 |= 0x40. verified (town MDT script).

accessories.confidence: high for effects, medium for community locations

crests_and_keys.name: Elf Crest
crests_and_keys.found: given by the Llama girl after Paguro is defeated (flag 0x30); sets 0x34 |= 0x80. verified (towns.json).
crests_and_keys.use: Llama villagers talk to you; story gate toward Pureza (community).

crests_and_keys.name: Crest of Glory
crests_and_keys.use: exchanged at the Tumba weapon shop for the Knight's Sword; consumed. Optional (Knight's Sword can also be bought in Dorado).

crests_and_keys.name: Hero's Crest
crests_and_keys.found: slash the large trunk in the Cavern of Riza (world 3); 200FIGHT entity handler sets 0x9C. verified.
crests_and_keys.use: Bosque sentry lets you pass toward Pollo.

crests_and_keys.name: Key
crests_and_keys.use: one consumed per ordinary locked door, including boss lair doors.

crests_and_keys.name: Lion's Head Key
crests_and_keys.use: opens the special doors in Tesoro (Arrugia) and Final.

crests_and_keys.name: Tear of Esmesanti
crests_and_keys.found: one per main boss, collected through the post-victory exit door (cut-scene 300ROKAD). Paguro gives none.

consumables.rules: 5 inventory slots (0xA6..0xAA); the same item may fill several slots. Used from the inventory screen (201SELCT) while in a cavern. Prices by town and stock below; shopkeeper texts in towns.json.

list.name: Ken'ko Potion
list.effect: +80 HP (heal pulse: +8 HP per frame for 10 frames), capped at max.

list.name: Elixir of Kashi
list.effect: refills the charges of the currently selected spell to its max.

list.name: Magia Stone
list.effect: summons 4 spirits orbiting the hero; each has 80 hits; damage per hit (level+1)*4, cap 255 (Get_Stats source 9).

list.name: Holy Water of Acero
list.effect: shield HP += [80,90,100,110,115,120][shield tier-1], capped at shield max.

list.name: Sabre Oil
list.effect: 0xE4 += 1; sword damage multiplied by (0xE4 + 1), cap 255. Stacks. Cleared on entering any town.

list.name: Kioku Feather
list.effect: warps to the town in 0xC5 (last sage) without a death penalty. In DOS 0xC5 is never updated, so it always returns to Muralla.

consumables.evidence: effects: 201SELCT item handlers (use_holy_water clamp to 0x96, E4 increment) and 200FIGHT heal pulse (0xC6, +8/frame). Stock: stdply 0xC9..0xD1 defaults 8A A6 6B 75 42 4C 4B 01 FF.

drop_codes.effect: blue potion: heals to full (heal pulse maxHP/8 + 1 frames of +8)

cavern_pickups.drop_selection: On death: the record's preset code (MDT byte +7 low nibble) if non-zero, else descriptor[rng & 3]; downward thrust forces descriptor[0]. Pickups fall and are collected by touch. See enemies.json mechanics.drops.
cavern_pickups.fixed_objects: Chests, wall stashes, keys, shoes, crests and Tears are placed in the map data; their placements and save flags are in game/data/world/ (owned by the map agent).
cavern_pickups.confidence: high for codes; placements not in this file

conflicts.code: only via Crest of Glory exchange (listed at 4900 but refused)
conflicts.community: sometimes listed as buyable / Elf Crest

conflicts.code: reach not traced; the known sword gate (Vista) is a damage multiplier

gaps: Exact chest/key placements are map data (game/data/world/), not listed here.
Whether selling a magic item adds it to the shop's stock was not checked.
Silkarn, Feruza, Crest of Glory and Lion's Head Key locations are from community sources.
